nodes.question: How can collaborative relationships and partnerships be beneficial in supplier governance?
nodes.answer: Collaborative relationships and partnerships, such as long-term orientation in supplier selection and working with external stakeholders, have been suggested to benefit supplier governance by reducing turnover, developing capacity programs, and leveraging influence through mutualization.
